warnings: This is the STRUCTURAL steel roof framing plan (ridge/purlins/rafters with sections and grid positions) — extracted under plan_beam scope as pattern 'plan', per op04's explicit roof_plan trap rule; the architectural roof sheet (eave lines, roofing material, slope arrows) is on the A-series and out of op04 scope.

The ridge (อกไก่เหล็ก) sits 0.60m beyond (north of) grid A — this offset is printed but not itself a beam-endpoint-driven dummy grid line (nothing else frames into that offset row), so it is recorded as a text grid_ref rather than a new grid master entry; the 0.60m value is logged in the grid master's unassigned_dimensions[].

Purlin ('แปเหล็ก') spacing is printed as a maximum ('@ไม่เกิน 0.80 เมตร'), not an exact count/position — recorded as one repeating-member entry with spacing_mm rather than enumerating individual purlins, since the drawing does not dimension each one.

Rafter ('จันทันเหล็ก') spacing is printed only as '@ระยะตามแบบ' (per this drawing / scaled) with no numeric callout. Three rafter positions ARE grid-dimensioned (they align with the column grid: 1, 1", 2) and are recorded at full confidence; the drawing also shows one additional un-dimensioned rafter line in each of the two bays (roughly mid-bay). Recorded those two as approximate/unresolved position rather than inventing a precise pos_m — a genuine gap in what this sheet prints, not a missed reading.
